boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: No-admission activities at Luther College and in Decorah, selected from public institutional and government sources.

cards.title: Tune Up at the Bike Fixit Station
cards.subtitle: Preus Library, Luther College
cards.notes: Bring a bike that needs attention, use the free pump and tools, and make a practical meet-up before riding elsewhere around campus.
cards.short_summary: A free self-service bike-maintenance stop beside Preus Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Luther College states that the Bike Fixit Station provides a free tire pump and tools for all Luther cyclists.
cards.source_title: Bike Share and Bike Fixit Station | Luther College
cards.access_notes: The station is beside the library's south-side bike racks; bring your own bicycle.

cards.title: Meet at Preus Library
cards.subtitle: 575 Library St., Luther College
cards.notes: Pick a table for a quiet catch-up, browse materials together, or use the public workstations without planning a purchase.
cards.short_summary: A campus library setting with posted building hours and public-facing computer access.
cards.evidence_claim: Luther lists Preus Library's building hours and states that its public kiosk workstations do not require a Luther Norse Key.
cards.source_title: Computer Labs and Classrooms | Luther College
cards.access_notes: Use during posted library hours; library schedules vary by term and break period.

cards.title: Visit Hanson Vesterheim Commons
cards.subtitle: Vesterheim campus, Decorah
cards.notes: Meet under the timber canopy, look through the welcome center and gallery if open, then continue into the adjacent outdoor heritage grounds.
cards.short_summary: A daily-open community space connected to Vesterheim Heritage Park.
cards.evidence_claim: Vesterheim states that Hanson Vesterheim Commons is open daily from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. with no admission charge.
cards.source_title: Vesterheim Commons Is Open | Vesterheim Norwegian-American Museum
cards.access_notes: Open daily 9 a.m.–5 p.m. according to Vesterheim; special-gallery availability can vary.

cards.title: See Decorah Ice Cave
cards.subtitle: Van Peenen Memorial Park, Decorah
cards.notes: Take the stairs to the cave entrance with a friend, use careful footing, and leave time to observe seasonal ice from a safe distance.
cards.short_summary: A named geological preserve with a narrow limestone cave passage.
cards.evidence_claim: Iowa DNR states that Decorah Ice Cave is open to the public free of charge.
cards.source_title: Decorah Ice Cave State Preserve | Iowa Department of Natural Resources
cards.access_notes: Footing can be hazardous and rocks may be loose; follow DNR cautions and do not disturb ice or rock.

cards.title: Watch Trout at the Hatchery
cards.subtitle: Decorah, Iowa
cards.notes: Walk the raceways, read the interpretive plaques, and use the picnic shelter for a conversation break without buying fish feed.
cards.short_summary: A public hatchery with raceways, interpretation, and a year-round shelter.
cards.evidence_claim: Iowa DNR states that the Chuck Gipp Decorah Fish Hatchery is open to the public 365 days a year from sunrise to sunset.
cards.source_title: New watershed plan improves water quality at the Chuck Gipp Decorah Fishery Hatchery | Iowa DNR
cards.access_notes: Public access is sunrise to sunset; fish feed is optional and is not needed for a visit.

cards.title: Walk a Section of Trout Run Trail
cards.subtitle: Starting near the Decorah Fish Hatchery
cards.notes: Choose a daylight out-and-back segment, walk at a conversational pace, and use the hatchery area as a simple start and finish point.
cards.short_summary: An 11-mile Decorah-area trail for a flexible walk or roll.
cards.evidence_claim: Iowa DNR identifies Trout Run Trail as an 11-mile route through Decorah and says the hatchery is a starting point for it.
cards.source_title: New watershed plan improves water quality at the Chuck Gipp Decorah Fishery Hatchery | Iowa DNR
cards.access_notes: Use daylight, account for weather, and share the multiuse trail courteously.

cards.title: Walk the Community Prairie
cards.subtitle: Decorah, Iowa
cards.notes: Follow the mowed walking paths, pause at the butterfly garden, and pick a short loop that fits the season and your group’s pace.
cards.short_summary: A city prairie with walking paths and a seasonal butterfly garden.
cards.evidence_claim: Decorah Parks and Recreation describes the Decorah Community Prairie as having mowed walking paths, a butterfly garden, and a community garden.
cards.source_title: Park Amenities & Descriptions | Decorah Parks and Recreation
cards.access_notes: Use the paths and respect seasonal planting areas and any posted site rules.

cards.title: Hang Out at Phelps Park
cards.subtitle: Park Street, Decorah
cards.notes: Bring a conversation, a book, or a game you already own, then use the overlooks, picnic area, playground, and hiking trail at your own pace.
cards.short_summary: Decorah’s first park, with a playground, shelters, lookouts, and trail.
cards.evidence_claim: Decorah Parks and Recreation identifies Phelps Park as the city's first park and lists its playground, picnic shelters, stone-walled lookouts, fountain, and hiking trail.
cards.source_title: Park Amenities & Descriptions | Decorah Parks and Recreation
cards.access_notes: Open public-park areas are suitable for a no-purchase visit; separately reservable facilities may have fees.

cards.entity_name: Dunning's Spring Waterfall and Stone Arch Bridge
cards.title: Walk to Dunning’s Spring Waterfall
cards.subtitle: Dunning's Spring Park, Decorah
cards.notes: Start at the park entrance, take the short approach to the waterfall and bridge, and use marked public paths for a low-key outdoor stop.
cards.short_summary: A named Decorah waterfall and stone bridge within the city’s park system.
cards.evidence_claim: Decorah Parks and Recreation's trail guide identifies Dunning's Spring Waterfall and Stone Arch Bridge and gives directions from Dunning's Spring Park.
cards.source_title: Decorah Parks and Trails Guide | Decorah Parks and Recreation
cards.access_notes: Stay on established public paths and check site conditions after storms or seasonal changes.

cards.entity_name: Carl Selland Wayside Park Ice Rink
cards.title: Skate at Carl Selland Wayside Park
cards.subtitle: Decorah, Iowa
cards.notes: When the rink is posted open, bring skates, meet in the warming house, and keep the hang simple by following the shared-rink rules.
cards.short_summary: A seasonal public ice-rink and warming-house activity.
cards.evidence_claim: Decorah Parks and Recreation states that use of the Carl Selland Wayside Park rink and warming house is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Decorah Parks and Recreation Rules and Regulations
cards.access_notes: Seasonal only; check the entrance sign or Parks and Recreation for ice-open status and warming-house hours.
